body:
Add the decision proposed in task:d41626ab51473623 (note 3, "Proposed decision") to DECISIONS.md, adjusted by the measured times from task:4f32c653e33b9caf.

- Rust projects held by symbol: one-crate Cargo packages, item naming (`board::agents::cached`, `Type::name`, `<Type as Trait>::f`).
- The subset and its refusals (note 3, section 2), and the brief lines for Rust projects.
- `cargo check --all-targets --message-format=json` per change; errors located by span.
- `build.rs`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `rust-toolchain.toml` and Cargo.toml's dependency and build keys are human-approved settings; bubblewrap without network on Linux.
- `syn` parsing, exact write-back, rustfmt on submit.
- Deferred: workspaces, proc-macro crates, type-accurate refs, extract/merge, probe.

Amend Specs 1, 2 and 14 to match. Documents only; no code.
title: Rust: record the store decision
